title: Shattering the Shortcut: A Topology-Regularized Benchmark for Multi-hop Medical Reasoning in LLMs
authors: Xing Zi; Xinying Zhou; Jinghao Xiao; Catarina Moreira; Mukesh Prasad
why_relevant: Introduces a medical multi-hop QA benchmark with hard negative distractors and shows RAG recovers performance, tangentially relevant to distraction/evaluation.
why_not_or_caveat: Focus is on shortcut learning in medical reasoning, not on RAG robustness, unreliable evidence, or calibration.
